t: The amendments made by the first section of this Act shall apply with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after January 1, 1968.

fable.w: This is an effective-date provision specifying when tariff amendments apply to imported articles. It contains no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue involving any party outside the federal government. There is no real tempting opposite reading; the mention of articles being entered or withdrawn by importers describes customs events, not participation in a federal decision.
fable.s: The amendments made by the first section of this Act shall apply with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after January 1, 1968.

qwen_block.w: This section is purely a temporal provision defining the effective date of previous amendments. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory boards, or coordination with outside parties. It merely states when the law applies.
qwen_block.s: The amendments made by the first section of this Act shall apply with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after January 1, 1968.

opus.w: This provision only sets the effective date for tariff or customs amendments. It does not provide for consultation, hearings, comment periods, advisory bodies, or a right to sue. The word "entered" refers to customs entry of goods, not to outside parties taking part in a federal decision.
opus.s: The amendments made by the first section of this Act shall apply with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after January 1, 1968.

qwen_chat.w: This section is an effective date provision that specifies when the amendments apply. It does not describe any process of consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government. It contains no requirements for public comment, hearings, advisory committees, or coordination with states or tribes.
qwen_chat.s: The amendments made by the first section of this Act shall apply with respect to articles entered, or withdrawn from warehouse, for consumption on or after January 1, 1968.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that because this section references "amendments made by the first section," and if that first section involved participation, this section implicitly requires it. However, this section itself is merely an effective date provision. It does not describe any process, consultation, hearing, or interaction with outside parties. It simply states when the law takes effect.
